dedupe_keys.name: multizone office building hvac operational scenarios

description: The building research team releases multizone office-building measurements under several HVAC operating scenarios. The public Figshare version-three deposit is CC BY 4.0 and lists 16 CSV files, including building operation tables, weather series and an information file. Coverage is one multizone office test building. The article describes more than 500 sensors monitoring zone conditions, supply and return air, flow and power. These series can calibrate a building energy model or test fault and control scenarios for heating and cooling demand. A caveat is that sensors, zones and operating modes are specific to one test building; simulation input mapping and time alignment need careful work. Weather and building records should be paired according to their scenario labels, not combined as a single continuous history. I read the own Figshare manifest and article Data Records without downloading CSVs, checking sensor calibration or running an HVAC model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
